name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Tab strip with an action-colored underline and the full WAI-ARIA keyboard model.

a11y.pattern: WAI-ARIA tabs: role=tablist / tab / tabpanel with roving tabindex
keyboard: Previous / next tab, wrapping. Selects it in automatic mode
Selects the focused tab in manual mode
Leaves the tab list for the selected panel
aria: aria-selected and aria-controls on each tab, aria-labelledby on each panel
Only the selected tab is in the Tab order (tabindex 0, others -1)
a11y.notes: Use tabs to switch views of one page, not to navigate between pages. Disabled tabs are skipped by the arrow keys. Set idPrefix when you render TabPanel outside Tabs.
